_howTo: Copy this file, edit it in Notepad, save, then in the app click Import (or drag the file onto the map) and choose 'Add to my map'.
Each item in 'nodes' is one card. Give every card a unique 'id' (any short text, e.g. 't1', 't2').
'parentId' is the id of the card it sits under. Use null for a main project or idea.
Dates are written YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-11-30. Use null for no date.
'assignee' is one person's name. 'assigneeTeam' is a team id from 'teams' (use one or the other, or neither).
'priority' is 'high', 'medium' or 'low'. Leave it out for no priority.
'teamIds' (on projects and ideas) lists the team ids working on it. 'members' lists extra people by name.
You can leave out any field you don't need. Positions are worked out by the app.
Keep the commas and quotes exactly like the examples: a missing comma makes the file invalid.
This _howTo section is ignored by the app, so you can delete it or leave it.
